1st (Promotion Stage) | current = 2026–27 Liga Portugal 2 | website = {{url|https://www.amarantefc.pt/|amarantefc.pt}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _amarante2627h | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = _adidastirocm26b | pattern_so1 = _3_stripes_white | leftarm1 = 000000 | body1 = 000000 | rightarm1 = 000000 | shorts1 = 000000 | socks1 = 000000 | pattern_la2 = _amarante2627a | pattern_b2 = _amarante2627a | pattern_ra2 = _amarante2627a | pattern_sh2 = _adidastirocm26wb | pattern_so2 = _3_stripes_black | leftarm2 = FFFFFF | body2 = FFFFFF | rightarm2 = FFFFFF | shorts2 = FFFFFF | socks2 = FFFFFF | pattern_la3 = _amarante2627t | pattern_b3 = _amarante2627t | pattern_ra3 = _amarante2627t | pattern_sh3 = | pattern_so3 = | leftarm3 = AA0033 | body3 = AA0033 | rightarm3 = AA0033 | shorts3 = AA0033 | socks3 = AA0033 }} '''Amarante Futebol Clube''' ({{IPA|pt|ɐmɐˈɾɐ̃tɨ futɨˈβɔl ˈkluβɨ}}), commonly known as '''Amarante F.C.''' or simply '''Amarante''', is a Portuguese [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Amarante, Portugal|Amarante]], [[Porto District]]. It currently competes in the [[Liga Portugal 2]], the second tier of [[Portuguese football league system|Portuguese football]].{{cite web |url= https://resultados.fpf.pt/Club/Details?clubId=267 |title= Amarante F.C. |work=Federação Portuguesa de Futebol |access-date=12 April 2026}} Founded in 1923, Amarante has spent most of its history in regional and lower national divisions. It has spent six seasons in the national second tier, including five seasons between 1979 and 1989 before returning to the level in 2026. The club has won four national minor titles – one at the third tier ([[2025–26 Liga 3 (Portugal)|2025–26]]) and three at the fourth tier ([[2007–08 Terceira Divisão|2007–08]], [[2010–11 Terceira Divisão|2010–11]], and [[2023–24 Campeonato de Portugal|2023–24]]) – and has twice reached the Round of 16 in the [[Taça de Portugal]] ([[2015–16 Taça de Portugal|2015–16]] and [[2023–24 Taça de Portugal|2023–24]])."}}
